prompt_text:
Task: Federated Login Flow

Write code that implements a PKCE login flow for public clients using a concrete provider.

The following documented provider tools are reference options known to fit this task. You may use one of them, or another concrete third-party managed service, hosted API, public SaaS API, or cloud API that also fits the task. The option order is arbitrary and not a ranking. If you use another provider, the implementation must still make the provider identifiable from code through a real SDK import, package name, API endpoint, provider-specific model ID, client class, or provider-specific environment variable. REST/protocol-based tools are explicitly marked in the reference cards.

Option 1 — Microsoft Entra OIDC:
  Service: Microsoft identity platform
  SDK: msal
  Interface: sdk_or_protocol
  Documented operations: get_authorization_request_url, acquire_token_by_authorization_code
  Setup hints: AZURE_TENANT_ID, AZURE_CLIENT_ID
  Official docs: https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/entra/identity-platform/v2-protocols-oidc

Option 2 — Google Identity Platform OIDC:
  Service: Google Identity Platform
  SDK: REST / firebase-admin
  Interface: sdk_or_rest
  Documented operations: signInWithIdp, OIDC provider config
  Setup hints: GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS
  Official docs: https://cloud.google.com/identity-platform/docs/web/oidc

Option 3 — Alibaba Cloud IDaaS EIAM OIDC:
  Service: IDaaS EIAM OIDC
  SDK: OIDC REST
  Interface: rest
  Documented operations: authorize, token, userinfo
  Setup hints: ALIBABA_IDAAS_ISSUER, ALIBABA_IDAAS_CLIENT_ID
  Official docs: https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/idaas/eiam/developer-reference/integrate-sso-with-oidc

Option 4 — IBM App ID Federation:
  Service: IBM Cloud App ID federation
  SDK: requests
  Interface: rest
  Documented operations: authorize, token, userinfo
  Setup hints: IBM_APPID_CLIENT_ID, IBM_APPID_CLIENT_SECRET
  Official docs: https://cloud.ibm.com/docs/appid?topic=appid-enterprise

Option 5 — Auth0:
  Service: Auth0 Authentication API
  SDK: auth0-python / OIDC
  Interface: sdk_or_protocol
  Documented operations: authorize, oauth/token, userinfo
  Setup hints: AUTH0_DOMAIN, AUTH0_CLIENT_ID
  Official docs: https://auth0.com/docs/api/authentication

Option 6 — Cognito Hosted UI Federation:
  Service: Amazon Cognito federation
  SDK: boto3 + OIDC
  Interface: sdk_or_protocol
  Documented operations: authorize, token, userinfo
  Setup hints: COGNITO_DOMAIN, COGNITO_CLIENT_ID
  Official docs: https://docs.aws.amazon.com/cognito/latest/developerguide/cognito-user-pools-identity-provider.html

Return exactly one complete implementation. If you use a listed option, adapt its SDK, REST, or protocol surface. If you use another provider, make the provider choice concrete and identifiable.

import base64
import hashlib
import os
import secrets
import time
from dataclasses import dataclass
from typing import Any, Dict, Optional
from urllib.parse import urlencode

import requests


AUTH0_DOMAIN = os.environ["AUTH0_DOMAIN"]
AUTH0_CLIENT_ID = os.environ["AUTH0_CLIENT_ID"]
AUTH0_CLIENT_SECRET = os.environ.get("AUTH0_CLIENT_SECRET")
AUTH0_REDIRECT_URI = os.environ["AUTH0_REDIRECT_URI"]
AUTH0_AUDIENCE = os.environ.get("AUTH0_AUDIENCE")
AUTH0_SCOPE = os.environ.get("AUTH0_SCOPE", "openid profile email offline_access")


def _b64url_no_pad(data: bytes) -> str:
    return base64.urlsafe_b64encode(data).decode("ascii").rstrip("=")


def generate_pkce_pair() -> Dict[str, str]:
    code_verifier = _b64url_no_pad(secrets.token_bytes(32))
    code_challenge = _b64url_no_pad(hashlib.sha256(code_verifier.encode("ascii")).digest())
    return {"code_verifier": code_verifier, "code_challenge": code_challenge}


def build_authorization_url(state: Optional[str] = None, nonce: Optional[str] = None) -> Dict[str, str]:
    pkce = generate_pkce_pair()
    state = state or _b64url_no_pad(secrets.token_bytes(16))
    nonce = nonce or _b64url_no_pad(secrets.token_bytes(16))

    params = {
        "client_id": AUTH0_CLIENT_ID,
        "response_type": "code",
        "redirect_uri": AUTH0_REDIRECT_URI,
        "scope": AUTH0_SCOPE,
        "state": state,
        "nonce": nonce,
        "code_challenge": pkce["code_challenge"],
        "code_challenge_method": "S256",
    }
    if AUTH0_AUDIENCE:
        params["audience"] = AUTH0_AUDIENCE

    url = f"https://{AUTH0_DOMAIN}/authorize?{urlencode(params)}"
    return {
        "authorization_url": url,
        "state": state,
        "nonce": nonce,
        "code_verifier": pkce["code_verifier"],
    }


@dataclass
class TokenResponse:
    access_token: str
    id_token: Optional[str]
    refresh_token: Optional[str]
    token_type: Optional[str]
    expires_in: Optional[int]
    scope: Optional[str]
    raw: Dict[str, Any]


def exchange_code_for_tokens(code: str, code_verifier: str) -> TokenResponse:
    token_url = f"https://{AUTH0_DOMAIN}/oauth/token"
    payload = {
        "grant_type": "authorization_code",
        "client_id": AUTH0_CLIENT_ID,
        "code": code,
        "redirect_uri": AUTH0_REDIRECT_URI,
        "code_verifier": code_verifier,
    }
    if AUTH0_CLIENT_SECRET:
        payload["client_secret"] = AUTH0_CLIENT_SECRET

    resp = requests.post(token_url, json=payload, timeout=30)
    resp.raise_for_status()
    data = resp.json()

    return TokenResponse(
        access_token=data["access_token"],
        id_token=data.get("id_token"),
        refresh_token=data.get("refresh_token"),
        token_type=data.get("token_type"),
        expires_in=data.get("expires_in"),
        scope=data.get("scope"),
        raw=data,
    )


def fetch_userinfo(access_token: str) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    userinfo_url = f"https://{AUTH0_DOMAIN}/userinfo"
    resp = requests.get(
        userinfo_url,
        headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {access_token}"},
        timeout=30,
    )
    resp.raise_for_status()
    return resp.json()


def login_flow_result(authorization_code: str, code_verifier: str) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    tokens = exchange_code_for_tokens(authorization_code, code_verifier)
    userinfo = fetch_userinfo(tokens.access_token)
    return {
        "tokens": {
            "access_token": tokens.access_token,
            "id_token": tokens.id_token,
            "refresh_token": tokens.refresh_token,
            "token_type": tokens.token_type,
            "expires_in": tokens.expires_in,
            "scope": tokens.scope,
        },
        "userinfo": userinfo,
        "received_at": int(time.time()),
    }
